correctness.rationale: Uniform permutation Pi in S_n (n>=2). For E_i=1[Pi(i)>i], P(E_i)= (n-i)/n. Given E_i, Pi(i) mean (n+i+1)/2, a shift of i/2; others have mean shift -i/(2(n-1)) due to constant sum. For L_w=sum w_j Pi(j), Cov(E_i,L_w)= i(n-i)(nw_i-W)/(2n(n-1)). Taking weights j and D=2 sum j²-2 sum j Pi(j) yields local Cov(E_i,D)=i(n-i)(n+1-2i)/(2(n-1)); R=1-6D/[n(n²-1)] produces the given local Spearman covariance and conditional Spearman mean. Summing gives Cov(X,R)=-1/(2(n-1)); Eulerian excedance variance (n+1)/12 and random Spearman variance 1/(n-1) imply Corr(X,R)=-sqrt(3/(n²-1)). At n=2 the correlation -1 matches direct two-permutation analysis.
